cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The plumber said isolate it, so I've closed the bathroom door. You've been working all night; sit down and I'll bring lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He meant turn off the water. It's coming under the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, the water next. Just a little drying to do. Take the sofa; I'll put a tray there for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll find the stopcock before I sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me which cupboard it's in and keep your feet up. I'll do that and bring the tray; you're not spending your morning on the floor.
